component.name: ApiTask
component.script: sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub sub run() ut = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") ut.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") ut.InitClientCertificates() ut.RetainBodyOnError(true) ut.AddHeader("User-Agent", "KateMobileAndroid/109.1 lite-550 (Android 13; SDK 33; arm64-v8a; Google Pixel; ru)") url = m.top.url sep = "?" p = m.top.params if p <> invalid then for each k in p url = url + sep + k + "=" + ut.Escape(p[k].toStr()) sep = "&" end for end if ut.SetUrl(url) body = ut.GetToString() data = ParseJson(body) if data = invalid then data = {error: {error_msg: "network/parse error"}} m.top.result = {tag: m.top.tag, data: data} end sub
